summary: Houses 8-11 m from the kerb all along, on a steep slope.
reasons: Dwellings 8-11 m away along whole kerb

best_section.where: East kerb of Taringa Parade, mid-block between the two side streets

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 10 m (at 12 m), 11 m (at 24 m) and 8 m (at 36 m) on the same side; no section clears 10 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerbside lane, one car parked at the south end; room to pull in at the kerb.
drivers.convention: One car parked at the south end in Esri; little other kerb parking visible.

sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb from the west; houses and trees on the east side give morning shade.
